VI.description: eDyno NVH simulator + CAN (eDyno_NVH_PoC.dbc\2C CAN FD) - copy of eDyno NVH Accel + RPM Simulator.vi with an NI-XNET Signal Output Single-point session on the PXIe-8510 Port1. Once per AO block it publishes DYNO_Cmd\2C DYNO_Status\2C SIM_FaultCmd\2C SIM_FaultStatus and SIM_Config; NI-XNET retransmits each frame at its DBC cycle time (10/100/1000 ms) with the latest values. FlexLogger on Port2 (loopback) logs them next to the raw accel. DynoSts_BlockCounter = AO block index.\0A\0AManual\3A leave Run Auto Sequence OFF and toggle Fault Injection / Speed Profile on the panel. Automated\3A switch Run Auto Sequence ON - each row of Steps is applied for Dwell (s)\2C the run-up restarts at every step\2C Test Step increments; after the last row the panel values apply again (Seq State 3 = AutoDone).\0A\0ASetup\3A import eDyno_NVH_PoC.dbc as XNET database alias eDyno_NVH_PoC (NI-XNET Database Editor or MAX) and confirm the cluster is CAN FD+BRS\2C 500 kbit/s / 2 Mbit/s. CAN Interface = the 8510 port wired to FlexLogger's port (default CAN1).
